title: Adding an Issue to the Entra ID Issue Safelist

blocks.text: If an issue of a scanned Entra ID tenant on the Detailed Findings and Recommendations page in the Entra ID dashboard doesn't pose any risk, you can mark it as safe by adding it to the Entra ID Issue Safelist.

After you add an issue to the safelist, it disappears from the Detailed Findings and Recommendations page and vulnerability report for the selected Entra ID tenant only. This issue is not marked safe if you select a different scanned Entra ID tenant.
To add an issue to the Entra ID Issue Safelist:

blocks.item: Go to ITDR > Dashboard > Entra ID.
On the Entra ID Dashboard page:
Select a tenant from the Result for drop-down menu.
Select a timestamp from the scanned on drop-down menu.
The scan result for the selected tenant appears.
Under Detailed Findings and Recommendations, click an issue.
On the Detailed Findings and Recommendations page, click Add Issue to Safelist for the selected issue.
In the Add to Safelist window, enter a reason for marking the issue safe and set an expiration date if needed.
The issue is added to the safelist. You can view and manage it from the Entra ID Issue Safelist.
